title: PhD Program
institution: Graduate School of Business and Economics (GSBE), University of Basel
about: The University of Basel's Graduate School of Business and Economics calls for applications to PhD positions supervised by professors listed in each call. For a PhD starting in fall 2027, the deadline is 31 January 2027; applications go through the university portal.
requirements: Completed application form, CV, degree diplomas with transcripts and a scientific writing sample
Application via the University of Basel online portal with CHF 100 application fee

upskill.name: the Data Analytics Academy
why: Shortlisted courses above the minimum score matched only on generic words ("computer", "vision", "program"), not business or economics; fallback to the closest Academy page.

Field "Business and economics" → Data Analytics Academy, e.g. A005.02 objective "Apply causal inference and experimental-design principles through A/B testing, randomized controlled trials, and quasi-experimental approaches to distinguish correlation from causal effects."
